verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: its homepage says inboxes can be created, managed, and operated "entirely via API," and even agent signup returns an API key programmatically. The documented API surface covers inboxes, messages, threads, drafts, labels, lists, attachments, pods, scoped keys and permissions, webhooks, and WebSockets, backed by a published OpenAPI spec, CLI, and MCP server. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, confirmation that console-only tasks (custom domain setup, API key creation, billing) are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration.
